Investment Rationale: • Base Lead - Acid business: Strong Franchise with Sustained Growt h: EIL continues to demonstrate the strength of its core lead-acid franchise, led by dominant market share in the OEM segment, and aptly supported by high-margin aftermarket domain.

The company has demonstrated the ability to grow across both OEM and replacement channels simultaneously, with automotive OEM growth exceeding 25% for the quarter and the replacement business delivering double-digit growth for the fourth consecutive quarter.

EIL has moved beyond the initial capex phase and has entered the customer validation and commercialisation stage, with LFP cell revenues already commencing from October and NMC cell validations progressing with leading two-wheeler OEMs.
